title: ‘If we wait we lose out’: Committee lays out plan to seize AI boom
headline: Joint committee recommends regulatory scrutiny and mandatory model sharing for AI firms
summary: A joint committee tabled a report with 46 recommendations following a three-month probe into artificial intelligence. The bipartisan report serves as a blueprint for the Albanese government as it finalises Australia's first legislated standards for AI firms. Frontier artificial intelligence firms operating in Australia face a wave of regulatory scrutiny and mandatory sharing of new models with safety and security agencies under the plan.
why_it_matters: Organisations operating frontier AI models in Australia must prepare for potential mandatory model sharing with safety and security agencies alongside new legislated standards.

quotes.text: Frontier artificial intelligence firms operating in Australia face a wave of regulatory scrutiny and mandatory sharing of new models with safety and security agencies under a plan from a joint committee that probed the tech for the last three months.
